title: Update SCHC property tests for validated IPv6 and Rule 255 registry
description: The full Python gate has two deterministic failures in python/tests/test_hypothesis.py after the Version 3 SCHC contract changed: test_schc_packet_roundtrip still feeds arbitrary 0..1280-byte blobs to compress_packet, which now correctly accepts only validated complete IPv6 packets, and test_rule_id_validity still asserts Rule 255 is absent even though the immutable operational registry now intentionally contains the empty UNCOMPRESSED_RULE marker. Replace the arbitrary-blob roundtrip with independently generated valid IPv6 packets plus invalid-input rejection properties, and assert Rule 255's marker invariants instead of absence.
